questions.prompt_html: \int_{0}^{1} dx \int_{0}^{x} dy \int_{0}^{y} \frac{\sin z}{1-z} dz \text{ 的值为 } \ \ ( )
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}\int_{0}^{x} dx \int_{0}^{y} dy \int_{0}^{z} \frac{\sin z}{1-z} dz&=\int_{0}^{1} dy \int_{0}^{y} dz \int_{y}^{1} \frac{\sin z}{1-z} dx\\&=\int_{0}^{1} dy \int_{0}^{z} \frac{\sin z}{1-z} (1-y) dz&=\int_{0}^{1} dz \int_{z}^{1} \frac{\sin z}{1-z} (1-y) dy\\&=\frac{1}{2} \int_{0}^{1} (1-z) \sin z dz&=\frac{1}{2} (1-\sin 1)\,.\end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{三重积分} \iiint x ^ { 2 } d v \ \text{(其中 } \Omega \ : \ x ^ { 2 } + y ^ { 2 } + z ^ { 2 } \leq 1 \text{ ) 的值为( ).}
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{原式} & = \iiint\limits_{\Omega} x^{2} dv \\ & = \int_{-1}^{1} x^{2} dx \iint\limits_{x^{2}+y^{2}\leq 1-x^{2}} dy dz \\ & = 2 \int_{0}^{1} x^{2} \pi (1-x^{2}) dz \\ & = \frac{4}{15} \pi \enspace 。 \end{aligned}

questions.prompt_html: \text{三重积分} \iiint \limits _ { \Omega } ( x ^ { 2 } + y ^ { 2 } + z ^ { 2 } ) d v \ \text{(其中}\Omega\ :\ x ^ { 2 } + y ^ { 2 } + z ^ { 2 } \leq 1 \text{ ) 的值为( \ \ )}.
questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{因为}\,\, \Omega\,\,\,\text{关于三个坐标面对称，于是} \\ \text{原式} &= \iiint\limits_{\Omega} (x^2+y^2+z^2) dv \\ &= 3 \iiint\limits_{\Omega} z^2 dv \\ &= 3 \int_{-1}^{1} z^2 dz \iint\limits_{z^2+y^2 \leqslant 1-z^2} dx dy \\ &= 6 \int_{0}^{1} z^2 \pi (1-z^2) dz \\ &= \frac{4}{5}\pi\,\,\, 。 \end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \iiint\limits_{\Omega} (1+x^{4})dv=\int_{2}^{4}dx\iint\limits_{D}(1+x^{4})dydz\ \ =\pi\int_{2}^{4}x^{2}(1+x^{4})dx\ \ =2340{\frac{20}{21}}\pi

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{由对称性知：}\iiint\limits_{\Omega} (ax+cz)dv=0\ ,\ \text{球体}\ x^{2}+y^{2}+z^{2}\leq 2y\ \text{的形心坐标为}(0,1,0)\ ,\ \text{由形心坐标公式}\\&\overline{y}=\frac{\iiint\limits_{\Omega} ydv}{V}\ ,\ \text{可知}\ \iiint\limits_{\Omega} ydv=V\overline{y}=V\ =\frac{4}{3}\pi\\&\text{所以，原式}=\frac{4b}{3}\pi\ .\end{aligned}
